plugins.name: arkandia
plugins.description: Arkandia's toolkit of AI coding-agent skills. `agent-context-dotnet` generates AGENTS.md and supporting docs (architecture, ADRs, data model, infrastructure) for a .NET repository, plus a `docs/dotnet.md` deep-dive — target frameworks, central package management, Aspire, EF Core, DI, packaging, analyzers, CI — and validates key generated claims with you to cut hallucinations. `linear-plan-build` and `ado-plan-build` take a ticket from read → grill you on the open design decisions → explore → plan → adversarial review → approval only when the change warrants it → test-first build → your repo's gates → PR → babysit CI to green, bound to Linear + GitHub and to Azure Boards + Azure Repos + Pipelines respectively. English or Spanish output.
